regime.summary: Policy rate held at 11.5% on 2026-06-15 while the 6M bill cutoff sits above it and CPI jumped from 6.99% to 11.64% in three months: the market prices hikes the SBP has not made. Index is up strongly (KSE100 +19.9% 3m). The hike-cycle analogue says hold bills and wait; Brent falling is a partial offset. Neutral, small exposure.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 11.5%; last MPC decision 2026-06-15: hold (+0bp)
Regime: 6M T-bill minus policy rate +0.99pp (market pricing hikes); CPI rising over 3 months (+4.7pp)
CPI YoY 11.64% for 2026-05 (published by 2026-06-03); three months earlier (2026-02) 6.99%
Tightening plus external stress: rate up 800bp in ten months with CPI above it.

core.thesis: Cheapest and highest-yielding liquid name in the pack; sits 0.9% below its 252-day high so price is not depressed. Held as a small value position, not a conviction call. Pack gives no cash-flow detail, so size stays small.
Low P/E and 6.8% yield, near its high. Risks: Brent is down 27.5% in three months and EPS is down year on year, so this is a modest value position with an oil-price risk I cannot size from the pack.
